title: Load Deepgram attachments in TactusScore
description: Add TactusScore support for resolving Deepgram payloads from attachment metadata, matching the existing LangGraphScore behavior, and cover it with focused tests.

comments.author: ec2-user
comments.text: Starting with a failing focused test for TactusScore attachment-key timestamp enrichment. No client-specific data is recorded; fixtures use synthetic generic keys and transcript text.

comments.author: ec2-user
comments.text: Implemented shared Deepgram attachment loading for score timestamp enrichment and wired TactusScore to use attached Deepgram JSON metadata. Local focused regression reproduced the pre-fix failure; full local verification deferred to GitHub CI after the staging instance became unstable.
